product_one_liner.value: ON3 Works uses proprietary AI and technical vetting to source, assess, and shortlist engineers, developers, and IT specialists for employers hiring in the United Kingdom and Spain.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its technical recruiting service and its target employers/markets.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists Agentic and Atelier plans and their success-fee rates.

named_customers.notes: The company facts table names CGI as a notable client, but no second customer name appears there.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 14 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: ON3 Works identifies its remote-first headquarters as Mallorca, Spain; its co-founder is located in Palma and third-party location listings identify a Palma de Mallorca office. LinkedIn metadata also marks London as primary, so Palma is the best-supported city-level reading of the company’s stated Mallorca base, with some location-source inconsistency.

founded_year.notes: The company states that it was founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The index is mainly hiring research and comparisons, with one explainer about the AI pipeline; it does not show the two engineering/build posts required.

public_docs.notes: The homepage footer has no Docs/Help link, and the About page contains only a single FAQ section rather than a multi-article documentation center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current company listing shows 0 jobs; no AI/ML/data-science opening is listed.

model_provider.notes: The privacy notice identifies OpenAI and Google Gemini for resume extraction and Cohere for matching embeddings.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy notice names UK GDPR; it does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn describes ON3WORKS as unfunded and says it has not raised funding; no round amount or date applies.

raised_18mo.notes: The company is reported as unfunded with no funding rounds, so no round occurred in the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current company listing shows 0 jobs, including no SDR, BDR, sales representative, or account executive role.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete small team page identifies the two founders, both associated with the company since its 2022 founding, and shows no recent C-level/VP join or departure.
